_meta.note: Unrecovered original-server behavior. Do not relabel these values as source facts.

decisions.HPD-001: Use HorcruxRepository over PlayerState.spirit_list plus minimal server-only player.horcrux.horcrux_state; never StackInventory authority.
decisions.HPD-002: Allocate positive per-player monotonically increasing spirit_id values. Initialize/repair next_spirit_id=max(1,persisted_cursor,max(existing spirit_id)+1). Allocate current cursor then increment inside the same PlayerUnitOfWork. Never reuse deleted IDs.
decisions.HPD-003: Choose uniformly from the exact source main selector candidates for the Spirit model. If only one candidate exists, choose deterministically with no entropy draw.
decisions.HPD-004: Interpret sub_num_rate positionally as counts 0..sub_num and draw using the exact source weights.
decisions.HPD-005: For the drawn secondary count, select source secondary selectors uniformly without replacement, preserving draw order as sub-list order. Do not additionally exclude a secondary solely because its materialized attribute matches the main attribute.
decisions.HPD-006: Fresh instances start lev=0, exp=0, is_equip=0, is_lock=0, collo_count=0. main/sub store 1-based source selector indices; main_attr/sub_attr use aligned source attribute IDs; initial main_attr_value/sub_attr_value use aligned source base values exactly with no hidden variance.
decisions.HPD-007: Process each crossed milestone 3,6,9,12,15 in ascending order. If no secondary exists, ADD is forced. If current secondary count has reached model sub_num, IMPROVE is forced. Otherwise choose ADD vs IMPROVE 50/50. ADD selects uniformly from currently absent source secondary selectors and appends it at aligned base sub_value. IMPROVE selects one existing secondary entry uniformly and adds that selector's aligned sub_strth.
decisions.HPD-008: Consume all client-selected valid fodder and charge Mana on the full gained-EXP preview, then clamp stored target EXP to the level15 cumulative maximum and discard excess. Final lev=15 and no banked post-cap EXP.
decisions.HPD-009: Evaluate repeat-pool rows independently in stable source row order using base10000 rate decomposition: guaranteed=rate//10000 plus one Bernoulli for residual=rate%10000. Each successful quantity materializes that many unique Horcruxes. No normalized one-of-N draw and no artificial at-least-one fallback.
decisions.HPD-010: Treat 2000 as a soft Gods Trial entry cap, not a destructive storage ceiling. Reject manual/auto Trial start when current owned count>=2000, matching client. If an already-authorized reward transaction crosses 2000, settle all generated rewards atomically and allow temporary overflow; subsequent Trial starts remain blocked until the player reduces count. MID241 source-authorized gifts are not truncated solely by the Trial cap.
decisions.HPD-011: Keep backend MID241 settlement canonical: selected type24 choice becomes a generated unique Horcrux returned in spirit_awards, never an ordinary stack award. During implementation, ship a bounded OTA client patch to SelectEquipWindow so its success path calls handleRewards(awards,nil,spirit_awards), matching GiftbagUseWindow. Do not invent a special server award plane.
decisions.HPD-012: Preserve raw corrupt source rows as provenance but expose an effective compatibility overlay for TOP Def Pack B with canonical ordered candidates [250000264,250000265,250000266,250000464,250000465,250000466,250000664,250000665,250000666,250000864,250000865,250000866] and sibling-consistent weights [84,84,84,84,83,83,83,83,83,83,83,83] (sum1000). Generic gift/dropbox weighted-selection semantics remain Gift-domain owned.
decisions.HPD-013: Allow Oath family1011 to be equipped like other position-compatible Horcruxes. It contributes its normal generated attributes but no suit bonus. Keep its high base EXP/fodder role unchanged.
